judged_text: poll_feed calls CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) without guarding against feeds whose items have no content element, so a nil content raises NoMethodError and aborts the entire hourly import mid-loop. Any feed entry lacking <content> (link-only feeds are common) crashes the job before later items are processed; with sidekiq_options retry: false the feed silently stops importing every hour until the feed changes or someone debugs the logs — and each crash point advances as earlier items got imported, producing partial, order-dependent state.

adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, the loop does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If a feed item lacks a `content` element (common in RSS), `i.content` can be nil, and calling `.scrub` on nil will raise `NoMethodError`, aborting the job mid-loop. The diff also sets `sidekiq_options retry: false`, so this failure would not be retried and could repeatedly prevent imports.
